title: The Mirror Witch
story: In the Hall of Mirrors lurks Multiplia the Mirror Witch. Every time she is struck, she splits into 2 copies of herself! She is all alone now, cackling in the moonlight. A careless knight might swing 4 times before noticing the room filling up...
question: If Mr 6 strikes carelessly 4 times, how many witches would surround him?
hint: Each strike doubles the witches: 1 becomes 2, 2 becomes 4... keep doubling, 4 times in all.
victory: Sixteen witches?! No thank you. Mr 6 lowers his sword, polishes his shield to a perfect mirror, and shows Multiplia her own reflection — she's so startled she splits in half and both halves flee!
solution: Start with 1 witch and double for each careless strike: 1 x 2 = 2 after the first strike.
Keep doubling: 2 x 2 = 4, then 4 x 2 = 8, then 8 x 2 = 16 after the fourth strike.
Mr 6 would be surrounded by 16 witches.
praise: You spotted that the witches multiply instead of just adding — nice thinking! The missing piece was doubling a full four times.
